name: PRE-CAPITAL
what_it_funds: Founder time, retail ingredients, phone photography, free modelling
what_it_unlocks: Personal prototype baseline; digital blueprint; data room
risk_removed: Idea risk: is the concept coherent, and can the founder cook it at home?

name: MICRO VALIDATION CAPITAL
what_it_funds: Ingredients, supplier samples, transport, basic photo materials, small lawful tastings
what_it_unlocks: Repeated prototypes; first real cost data; possible small tastings
sources_to_consider: founder savings; friends and family only if the founder chooses
what_must_be_true_first: Session 1 completed; decision gate BG-2 not passed for sale
risk_removed: Product risk: do the dishes hold up, and what do they really cost?

name: PRE-SEED / CONCEPT CAPITAL
what_it_funds: Legal and IP, formation, food and beer pilots, brand finalization, insurance
what_it_unlocks: Name decision; professional reviews; commercial pilots
sources_to_consider: angels; hospitality investors; strategic or brewery partners; grants if any
what_must_be_true_first: blueprint, prototype evidence and risk disclosure ready
claim_status: NOT RAISED; no fundraising target set
risk_removed: Name, legal and demand risk: can the concept lawfully operate, and do strangers want it?

name: SITE CAPITAL
sources_to_consider: hospitality investors; partners; possible debt later
what_must_be_true_first: pilots show demand and unit economics
risk_removed: Site risk: can a real place support the kitchen and brewery?

name: BUILD CAPITAL
sources_to_consider: investors; SBA or other debt where appropriate; landlord contribution
risk_removed: Build risk: can it be built within what evidence supports?

name: OPENING CAPITAL
risk_removed: Opening risk: can the team serve guests safely and consistently?
